lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: High-intensity circular clusters are arranged in a multi-row grid posterior to the gills, with the most prominent spots located along the mid-lateral line.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical high-luminance bands are visible intersecting with the spots, creating a defined checkerboard structural appearance on the flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A linear feature with a vertical intensity gradient (light upper, dark lower) extends horizontally along the upper dorsal-lateral boundary.

other_distinctive_markers: The pectoral fin exhibits a high-density population of smaller, high-luminance spots that differ in scale from the larger clusters on the main body flank.
